title: My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU (Oregairu)
native_title: やはり俺の青春ラブコメはまちがっている。
source: Oregairu light novels by Wataru Watari (14 volumes, main story finished).
world: Cynical loner Hachiman Hikigaya is forced by his teacher into the Service Club, where he helps students with their problems alongside the cold, perfect Yukino Yukinoshita and the cheerful Yui Yuigahama. His self-sacrificing methods solve problems but hurt the people around him, and the three slowly search for 'something genuine'. A sharp, introspective school drama.
power_system: No powers. Hachiman's weapon is sarcasm and reading people.

places.name: Service Club room
places.line: Club room where the three meet.

groups.name: Student Council
groups.line: Led by Iroha Isshiki after Hachiman helped her win.

terms.line: The club that takes students' requests.
Very sweet canned coffee Hachiman loves.

timeline.summary: Hiratsuka forces Hachiman into the Service Club.
Hachiman takes the blame to fix things.
His methods hurt Yukino and Yui; Iroha becomes president.
The three face their feelings; Hachiman and Yukino start dating.
